subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for booking your flight with us. We are pleased to confirm that your itinerary for the flight from New York to Los Angeles on July 15th, 2022, is all set. Please find attached your e-ticket for reference. Should you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
